name: switch
useFor: Use Switch for a setting that applies at once (auto-merge, notifications). Put it at the end of a setting row with the setting's name, or wrap it with its label in a Label. For a choice saved with a form use Checkbox.
constraints: A track in any on color but the orange
A knob with a drop shadow
A switch that applies only on submit
source: The Hoplite website's app demo switches (.pa-sw: 28 by 16, radius 8px, a 12px --day knob 2px in, --orange when on; .tt-sw: 20 by 12 with an 8px knob)
title: Switch
description: The product's switch from the site's app demo: a 28 by 16 rounded track in the off gray that turns orange when on, with a 12px knob of the ground that slides 12px. sm is the 20 by 12 switch.
